script: In 1946, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on its own fleet, and then a swimsuit was named after it. The target was Bikini Atoll, a tiny paradise in the Pacific whose people were quietly shipped away from their homes forever. Ninety empty warships were anchored together as a ghost fleet, waiting to be destroyed in a single nuclear experiment. On July twenty fifth, a bomb detonated deep underwater and hurled an entire mountain of radioactive sea into the sky. The falling spray coated every ship in invisible radiation that no crew could ever fully scrub away again. But the sailors were sent aboard anyway, mopping the poisoned decks in shorts while their commanders insisted it was perfectly safe. Here is the part almost nobody ever connects, because just days later a French designer revealed a tiny new swimsuit. He named it the bikini, betting it would shock the entire world exactly like the bomb that now shared its name. The ghost fleet stayed so radioactive that most of the ships were finally towed far out and sunk in the deep ocean. And to this day, millions of people wear the name of a nuclear disaster without ever knowing the secret behind it.

title: The Nuclear Bomb Test That Named Your Swimsuit
description:
July 1946: Operation Crossroads at Bikini Atoll. The US Navy detonated an atomic bomb underwater among 90 of its own warships, a radioactive 'ghost fleet' sailors were then sent to scrub by hand. Days later, a French designer named his shocking new two-piece swimsuit the 'bikini' after the atoll. The islanders never got their home back.
